scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Mongjin.xcodeproj -scheme Mongjin -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.sync:android: npx cap sync android && node scripts/fix-android-project.mjs
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run build && npm run sync:android && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
scripts.build:steam: npm run build:steam-web && npm run package --prefix apps/steam
